task: Frozen-config N=20 confirmation experiment (no further tuning)
purpose: confirm retrieval ranking produces stable benefit
confirm joint gate improves verification efficiency without adding question burden
confirm Phase-2B Brier improvement replicates across seeds and unseen cases

primary_subset.rule: exclude the 245 screen cases (first 5/disease in screen_case_manifest.csv); remaining 15/disease

secondary_pooled_subset.rule: full 980 cases (not described as fully independent)

frozen_config.note: weight, gate threshold, and stop thresholds are FROZEN; no tuning this phase

counterfactual.note: formal path is delete-only; do not claim delete/weaken/flip were all used

go_requires.criterion: pooled noise 0.2/0.3 Brier paired delta < 0 AND 95% CI upper bound < 0
Top-1 non-inferior: paired delta 95% CI lower bound >= -0.005
retrieval-triggered verification precision clearly above candidate misreport base rate
at least one primary clinical/safety endpoint improves NOT solely via more questions

acceptance_criteria.note: these criteria are written BEFORE running and must not be changed after seeing results

red_lines: no re-tuning of weights / gate thresholds / stop thresholds
no LLM / dense retriever / SFT / RL
no modification of existing formal results
no modification of preregistered success criteria
full N=20 not described as fully independent confirmation set
no evaluation truth in action decisions
no changing Go/No-Go thresholds based on results
